messages.content: Do standard current accounts have a monthly fee?

response: According to our public FAQ, standard current accounts at AtlasBank do come with a monthly maintenance fee. However, this can be waived if you meet certain conditions, such as maintaining a minimum balance or setting up direct debit payments from your account. You can find more details on our website under "Account Fees and Charges".
